question: Does the OpenVINO GenAI / CPU pipeline expose a chunked-prefill equivalent of NPUW_LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE?

npu_reference.note: NPUW_* properties apply to the NPU plugin / NPUW path only.

property_names_tried.name: NPUW_LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE
property_names_tried.result: NPU-specific; not a CPU plugin property. Present only in platform npu_config / manifest schema.

property_names_tried.name: PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE
property_names_tried.result: absent from openvino_genai.GenerationConfig dir() and from intel_cpu properties

property_names_tried.name: LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE
property_names_tried.result: not present in openvino.properties.intel_cpu (only TbbPartitioner exposed)

property_names_tried.name: CHUNK_SIZE
property_names_tried.result: not present on GenerationConfig; only WhisperDecodedResultChunk / streamer text chunks unrelated to prefill

property_names_tried.name: scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
property_names_tried.as: openvino_genai.SchedulerConfig field passed as LLMPipeline property
property_names_tried.result: EXISTS but is ContinuousBatchingPipeline scheduling (default 256), not a stateful-LLMPipeline activation bound equivalent to NPUW_LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE. Enabling it changes pipeline mode (prefix caching / paged attention semantics) and is not clearly safe for the E-FILTER CPU path.

property_names_tried.name: scheduler_config.dynamic_split_fuse
property_names_tried.result: EXISTS (default true) for ContinuousBatching only; splits prompt/generate scheduling phases, not a drop-in chunked-prefill knob for the current backend.

evidence: LocalOpenVinoBackend.properties() sets SCHEDULING_CORE_TYPE / ENABLE_CPU_PINNING / INFERENCE_NUM_THREADS only; constructs stateful LLMPipeline without scheduler_config.
OpenVINO GenAI docs: add {"scheduler_config": SchedulerConfig} to create continuous batching pipeline — a different execution path from the stateful CPU pipeline used here.

NPUW_LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE is required in run_manifest.schema.json under npu_config and documented in PHASE_MINUS1_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC for NPU dynamic-shape mitigation — CPU path has no parallel requirement.

config_flag.reason: No safe CPU equivalent to enable; flag records the negative audit only.

c9_implication.statement: On this stack (OpenVINO GenAI stateful LLMPipeline on CPU), usable agent context is bounded by prefill activation memory, not by KV cache size.
